context_for_next_testing_agent: All fixes verified: 1) Public branding endpoint at /api/public/branding returns 200 without auth with all expected fields (company_name, primary_color, logo_url, quote_header_text, quote_footer_text, etc.), 2) Public quote page /quote/{token} loads correctly with branding and quote data - no more 'Link Inválido' error, 3) Tire analysis endpoint /api/admin/reports/tire-analysis returns tire_sizes, brands, keywords with correct structure, 4) Rejection reasons endpoint /api/admin/reports/rejection-reasons returns by_reason, with_reason, without_reason, by_ticket_type (NOT 'reasons' field), 5) Reports page shows all sections: filters, customer stats, metrics, rejection analysis, tire analysis button.

public_branding_endpoint.returns: company_name, primary_color, logo_url, quote_header_text, quote_footer_text, company_phone, company_email, quote_page_accepted_title, quote_page_accepted_message, quote_page_rejected_title, quote_page_rejected_message

public_quote_endpoint.returns: ticket_number, customer_name, quote_value, quote_sent_at, quote_options, quote_decided_at, quote_decision, ticket_attachments

tire_analysis_endpoint.returns: total_tickets_analyzed, tickets_with_sizes, tire_sizes (size, count, percentage), brands (brand, count), keywords (keyword, count)

rejection_reasons_endpoint.returns: total_rejected, with_reason, without_reason, by_reason (code, label, count, percentage), by_ticket_type (type, count, percentage), period
rejection_reasons_endpoint.note: Fixed: returns by_reason instead of old 'reasons' field

reports_endpoint.returns: period, metrics (total_tickets, tickets_by_status, tickets_by_type, tickets_by_channel, sla_compliance_rate, tickets_overdue, quotes_sent, quotes_accepted, quotes_rejected, total_quote_value), agent_performance, daily_ticket_counts
